chapters.title: Asking for an Address
lines: Excuse me, could you help me, please?
Of course. What do you need?
Let me see. Which street is it?
I know it. It's not far from here.
How far is it on foot?
Yes, go straight for two blocks.

chapters.title: Taxi to the Airport
lines: Sure. Please put your bags in the trunk.
حتماً. لطفاً چمدان‌ها را در صندوق عقب بگذارید.
How long does it take to get there?
رسیدن به آنجا چقدر طول می‌کشد؟
My flight leaves at six. Will we make it?
Don't worry. We have plenty of time.

chapters.title: Check-in
lines: Good afternoon. Where is the check-in counter?
ظهر بخیر. باجه‌ی پذیرش پرواز کجاست؟
Which airline are you flying with?
I'm flying with Sky Air to London.
It's at counter fifteen, over there.
May I see your passport and ticket?
Please place it on the scale.
Is it within the weight limit?

chapters.title: Security & Gate
lines: Please put your bag on the belt.
لطفاً کیف را روی نوار بگذارید.
Do I need to take out my laptop?
لازم است لپ‌تاپ را بیرون بیاورم؟
Yes, and please remove your jacket.
بله، و لطفاً کتتان را دربیاورید.
Should I take off my shoes?
Do you have any liquids in your bag?
Just a small bottle of water.
I'm sorry, you'll need to throw it away.
متأسفم، باید آن را دور بیندازید.
That's fine. Can I go now?

chapters.title: Arrival & Directions
lines: Excuse me, where is baggage claim?
Follow the signs to the lower level.
تابلوها را تا طبقه‌ی پایین دنبال کنید.
Which belt is for the London flight?
کدام نوار برای پرواز لندن است؟
Please go to the lost luggage office.
لطفاً به دفتر چمدان‌های گمشده بروید.
Found it! Where is the exit?
Where can I get a taxi?
The taxi stand is outside, to the right.
ایستگاه تاکسی بیرون، سمت راست است.
